# The archived CLI links the untouched old generated client and messages.
# It must tolerate additive capabilities while default tasks retain their meaning.
server start
skygo info --target local --require finite-jobs-v1
stdout 'local +local +finite-jobs-v1'
legacy targets list
stdout 'NAME +KIND'
stdout 'local +local'
! stdout 'CAPABILITIES'
legacy --json targets list
stdout '"name": *"local"'
! stdout 'capabilities'
! stderr .
taskfile task.json marker
legacy plan -f task.json
stdout '^local\n$'
legacy --json run -f task.json --request-id old-client --wait
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
job-id JOB
exists marker
legacy --json run -f task.json --request-id old-client --wait
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
stdout '"state": *"JOB_STATE_SUCCEEDED"'
legacy --json jobs get $JOB
stdout '"id": *"'$JOB'"'
legacy jobs logs $JOB
stdout '^legacy-compatible workload\n$'
server stop
! stderr .
